title: Exercise
description: One exercise. The file lives at exercises/<id>.json. Fields marked with x-vocab must hold a value from the named file in vocab/; the validation script enforces membership so vocabulary growth is a data change.

id.description: Slug. Also the file name and the folder name under images/.

name.description: Canonical English name. Must describe a concrete action, not a goal or a body region.

aliases.description: Alternative English names for the same movement, for search. The catalogue's base language is English; translation is a consumer concern.

family.description: Slug of the family this exercise belongs to, or null when unclassified. Must resolve to a file in families/.

variantGroup.description: Free-text presentation sub-group inside a large family, for example "Incline" or "Kettlebell".

secondaryMuscles.description: Must not repeat a primary muscle.

measurementType.description: How a set of this exercise is measured. Intrinsic to the movement. Null means the exercise is a draft and not ready for workout use. Once set, curation policy treats it as immutable.

laterality.description: Whether the movement loads both sides at once (bilateral) or one side at a time (unilateral). Once set, curation policy treats it as immutable.

images.description: Paths relative to images/. The folder must equal the exercise id, and every file must exist.

source.description: Provenance of imported rows, kept for idempotent re-import and credit.
